newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova's Snegur leads in presidential vote.
newsitem.headline: Moldova's Snegur leads in presidential vote.

text.p: President Mircea Snegur was well ahead of other eight candidates in Moldova's presidential election, according to partial preliminary results released on Monday.

The Central Electoral Commission said that with 60 percent of Sunday's vote counted, Snegur had 38 percent and parliament chairman Petru Lucinschi was second on 26 percent. If no candidate wins over 50 percent, a runoff between the top two contenders will be held on December 1.
Prime Minister Andrei Sangheli had 10 percent, with Communist Party leader Vladimir Voronin suprisingly ahead of him on 11 percent.
Nationalist Valeriu Matei received nine percent of votes and four other candidates were far behind.
The turnout was 67 percent, the electoral commission said.

Sunday's poll was the first multi-party presidential election in Moldova, and most experts predicted a tight race between the president, leader of the parliament and the premier. Sangheli's poor result appeared a surprise.
